salt-grain.name: klroute
salt-grain.title: klroute - Waveguide & Metal Routing
salt-grain.doc: Route waveguides and metal for SiEPIC and SiEPIC-compatible PDKs: click corners like the Path tool, auto-route A to B around devices, or chain components. PDK waveguide types from WAVEGUIDES.xml, PDK waveguide / wire / bend cells, editable routes, metal layer changes with vias, grating couplers with opt_in labels and test coordinates, SiEPIC pins and DevRec for your own devices. Tools > Route (Waveguide / Metal), Ctrl+Shift+R / Ctrl+Shift+M.
salt-grain.author: Ram Mohan
